Spain Wins World Cup, Celebrations Erupt Globally

Spain has won its second World Cup title, defeating Argentina in the final. Coach Luis de la Fuente dedicated the victory to his squad and coaching staff, calling the players the architects of the win. Celebrations erupted in Madrid, with fans partying through the night. A viral moment showed Spanish player Lamine Yamal consoling Lionel Messi after the final match. The tournament was also marked by controversies, according to some reports.
